title: chore(deps): upgrade gray-matter to 3 and js-yaml to 5 (AI-assisted)
body:
## Breaking Changes

### TLDR

Most sites shouldn't be affected, unless you use fancy/deprecated YAML features or have custom `parseFrontMatter` logic to manage dates.

### Detailed

Adopts the YAML 1.2 Core defaults from [gray-matter 3](https://github.com/11ty/gray-matter/releases/tag/v3.0.0) and [js-yaml 5](https://github.com/nodeca/js-yaml/blob/master/docs/migrate_v4_to_v5.md).

- **Who does this affect**: Sites using YAML front matter, authors/tags files, or category metadata, particularly custom code consuming raw front matter.
- **How to migrate**: Dates/timestamps and binary integers (`0b10`) now remain strings; convert them explicitly where needed. Replace `<<` merges with explicit fields (anchors/aliases still work), remove legacy tags such as `!!timestamp`/`!!binary`/`!!set`, and replace complex mapping keys with scalar keys. Use `{}` for empty/comment-only YAML data files; empty front matter and whitespace-only tags files remain supported. Blog publication dates retain UTC defaults and explicit timezone offsets.
- **Why make this breaking change**: Adopt the maintained parser's standard defaults consistently across Docusaurus, without a legacy-schema compatibility layer.
- **Severity (number of people affected x effort)**: Low for typical sites; sites relying on legacy YAML features or raw `Date` objects must update their data/custom code.

## Pre-flight checklist

- [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines on pull requests](https://github.com/facebook/docusaurus/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests).
- [x] **If this is a code change**: I have written unit tests and/or added dogfooding pages to fully verify the new behavior.
- [ ] **If this is a new API or substantial change**: the PR has an accompanying issue (closes #0000) and the maintainers have approved on my working plan.

## Motivation

Upgrade `@11ty/gray-matter` 2.1.0 → 3.0.0 and all direct `js-yaml` dependencies 4.3.2 → 5.4.1. The latter respects the repository's seven-day release-age policy. Use namespace imports and bundled types, remove `@types/js-yaml`, and preserve timezone-aware blog dates. (AI-assisted)

## Test Plan

- `pnpm test`: 184 files, 3,039 tests passed, including YAML defaults, date parsing in three host timezones, and date-source precedence/fallbacks.
- `pnpm build:packages` and `pnpm build:website:fast`: passed.
- ESLint on changed source/tests, formatting, spelling, `pnpm lint:syncpack`, and `pnpm lint:deps`: passed (existing camelcase warnings only).
- Date parsing covers the [YAML timestamp syntax](https://yaml.org/type/timestamp.html), including tabs, whitespace and short offsets, plus ISO offsets without a colon. The regexp only detects a timezone; Joi validates dates.
- Reviewed date-string snapshots and replaced the invalid YAML fixture with syntax rejected by both parser versions.
- Argos and CI checks will run on this PR.

### Test links

Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-12462--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/

- [Blog](https://deploy-preview-12462--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/blog)
- [Docs](https://deploy-preview-12462--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/docs/next/installation)
- [Dogfooding](https://deploy-preview-12462--docusaurus-2.netlify.app/tests)

## Related issues/PRs

- Follows #12181.
